text_block_list.text:
On my way home after finishing work, I 
spotted Symboli Rudolf sitting in the 
track grandstands, her shoulders slumped.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Standing here and looking down at the 
course once more, the various shadows 
burned into my eyes come rushing back.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A shadow that continues to sprint full of 
vitality even now... and a shadow that can 
never be seen again.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Just wallowing in shame over my 
powerlessness won't move me forward. I 
understand that much.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However... every now and then, I can't 
help but regret it.
